b.answer:
Worked example: Prime Auto, a fictional used-car dealer in Ikeja with 5 sales staff.

Routing (in order)
1. Contact has an owner with an open deal → same owner
2. Enquiry is for trade-in valuation → valuations team rotation
3. Budget ≥ ₦40m → senior staff rotation
4. Otherwise → floor sales rotation (available only)
  • F1: stage → Test drive done: one task "Call for decision" tomorrow; re-enrol: yes (second test drive).
  • F2: Offer made 5 days, no activity: notify owner + manager once; re-enrol: no until stage changes.
  • F3: stage → Lost: lost reason required (dropdown).
mistakes: Follow-ups that fire on every field change.
No named owner for each automation.
b.pass: A routing rule in order (existing owner first) and three follow-ups, each with trigger, action, owner and re-enrolment choice, all firing on customer actions or timers, once.
b.redo: Send it back if any automation fires on noise, lacks an owner, or could notify repeatedly.

s.answer:
Worked example: HubSpot Sales Hub Professional trial.

TEST log
TEST·01 existing owner      → same owner ✓
TEST·02 trade-in            → valuations rotation ✓
TEST·03 ₦55m                → senior rotation ✓
TEST·04 owner unavailable   → skipped ✓
TEST·05 no activity 60 min  → re-rotated once, manager alerted once ✓
TEST·06 stage Test drive done twice → 2 tasks (re-enrol on) ✓
Workflows switched on: new records only

Automation register: 5 rows (id, name, where, trigger, does, owner, date). Test records deleted after testing.
mistakes: Switching on for all existing records.
Two workflows editing the same field.
s.pass: Routing and two follow-ups built, every branch tested with TEST records and logged, nothing firing twice, and a complete automation register.
s.redo: Send it back if a branch is untested, a loop or duplicate appears in the log, or the register is incomplete.

g.answer:
Worked example of evidence (anonymised): real sales team of 8 at an electronics wholesaler.

Two weeks before / after routing
Enquiry → owner (median) ....... 2 h 40 min → 4 min
First reply (office hours) ..... 3 h 10 min → 22 min
Automated tasks per rep per day  — → 4.2 (team: 'manageable')
Duplicate calls to same lead ... 9 → 0

Feedback: two reps asked for fewer stuck-deal alerts; threshold changed from 5 to 7 days and logged in the register.
mistakes: Changing automations without updating the register.
g.pass: Routing and follow-ups running for a real team for two weeks, with before-and-after times, task volume and team feedback, anonymised.
g.redo: Send it back if there's no before/after comparison or the team's experience of task volume isn't reported.
